description: This file defines an abstract generic entity class for persistence with JPA/Hibernate, providing common behaviors such as ID management, equality, string representation, and comparison for entities in the SalesManager application.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntity
classes.description: Abstract base class for all persistent entities in the SalesManager project, parameterized by ID type. Implements Serializable and Comparable, providing implementations for equals, hashCode, compareTo, and toString methods, as well as abstract methods for ID access.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the unique identifier of the entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Abstract method to set the unique identifier of the entity.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Returns true if the entity's ID is null, indicating it has not yet been persisted.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare entities based on their class (via Hibernate.getClass) and their ID.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on the ID field.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this entity with another of the same type based on their IDs.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the entity, including class name and ID.
